returns table (

  region text,
  full_name text,
  email_masked text,
  phone_masked text
)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select
    c.id,
    c.region,
    c.full_name,
    (case
      when auth.role() = 'service_role'

        select 1
        from public.supervisors
        where user_id = auth.uid()
      )
      then c.email
      when exists (
        select 1
        from public.support_agents
        where user_id = auth.uid()
          and region = c.region
      )
      then (
        split_part(c.email, '@', 1) || '***' || split_part(c.email, '@', 2)
      )
      else null
    end) as email_masked,
    (case
      when auth.role() = 'service_role'
      then c.phone
      when exists (
        select 1
        from public.supervisors
        where user_id = auth.uid()
      )
      then c.phone
      when exists (
        select 1
        from public.support_agents
        where user_id = auth.uid()
          and region = c.region
      )
      then '******' || (c.phone)::text[-4:]
      else null
    end) as phone_masked
  from public.customers c
  where auth.role() = 'service_role'
     or exists (
       select 1
       from public.supervisors
       where user_id = auth.uid()

         and region = c.region
     );
$$;
